title: Make the web client a correct installable iPad PWA
summary: The spa/ web client already ships a manifest, Apple meta tags, correctly sized icons, and a cache-free push service worker, so this stage closes the gaps that make iPad standalone behave wrong rather than adding PWA support from scratch. Add viewport-fit=cover so env(safe-area-inset-*) is non-zero in standalone; broaden the manifest scope from /app/ to / (with start_url still /app/) so the vendored-Skrift /auth/login redirect stays inside the installed app instead of bouncing to Safari; add manifest identity/orientation fields and reconcile theme_color/background_color to the app bg (#fafafa); make theme-color meta light/dark aware; and pad the app shell for iPad safe areas plus suppress standalone overscroll — all inset-based so desktop layout is unchanged. TDD via a new spa/test/pwa.test.js that reads index.html/manifest/styles.css and asserts the PWA fields. The service worker stays cache-free (E2EE never-serve-stale rule); splash screens and offline caching are deferred.
